caption: A cup of hot coffee stands on the dashboard of a cold car, and a patch of fog spreads on the windshield above it.

sa.check: A cup of hot coffee stands on a car's dashboard.
A patch of fog forms on the windshield above the cup.
The rest of the glass stays clear.
The steaming comes first and the patch follows.

pc.expect: The patch forms on the glass directly above the cup, where the steam reaches it, and the glass away from it stays clear.
pc.fail: The patch forms below the cup on the glass; or the patch forms on a part of the windshield the steam never reaches; or the whole windshield fogs evenly while the steam rises from one cup; or the patch forms on the outside of the glass.

pc.expect: The patch only grows while the coffee steams and does not clear on its own.
pc.fail: The patch clears while the coffee still steams; or the patch grows and shrinks in turn; or the glass is fogged before the cup is on the dashboard; or the patch jumps to a new place on the glass.

pc.expect: The steam rises from the cup to the glass and drops in the patch run downward on the inner face.
pc.fail: The steam sinks onto the dashboard and pools; or a drop in the patch runs up the glass; or the steam pours downward from the cup; or drops gather along the patch's top edge and stay.

pc.expect: The fog is a fine haze that beads and streaks, and the glass stays rigid and clear.
pc.fail: The fog stands off the glass as a thick crust; or peels away as a film; or the glass flexes where the patch lies; or the haze turns opaque white like paint.

pc.expect: One cup on one dashboard; the cup stays upright and nothing passes through the glass.
pc.fail: The cup vanishes; or a second cup appears; or the cup passes into the dashboard; or the coffee passes through the windshield.

pc.expect: The dashboard, the cup's markings and the view outside stay the same.
pc.fail: The dashboard changes colour; or the cup's markings change; or the scene outside jumps to a different place.
